duplication_audit.novel_axis: fixed ordered cross-channel equilibrium regression and residual mean-reversion geometry
duplication_audit.distinction: v33 DCCA measures scale-wise detrended correlation, v51 compares early/late SPD covariance, and v30 estimates discretized directed transfer dependence. v71 fits a static within-case equilibrium relation and characterizes its residual persistence and error correction.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: four past-only native channels transformed to the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.normalization: each response and regressor separately normalized by median and 1.4826 times MAD; zero-scale maps to zero
encoder.regression: deterministic zero-intercept OLS after robust centering

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Engle and Granger, Co-integration and Error Correction: Representation, Estimation, and Testing, Econometrica 55, 251-276 (1987)
primary_sources.use: equilibrium-error and error-correction motivation only; no P3 performance claim
